flowchart TD
  subgraph ADDON["Add-on Home Assistant"]
    CY["openclaw_assistant/config.yaml"] --> DK["openclaw_assistant/Dockerfile"]
    DK --> RS["openclaw_assistant/run.sh"]
  end
  subgraph GW["Passerelle et proxy"]
    OG["openclaw_assistant/oc-gateway"]
    PS["openclaw_assistant/openclaw-proxy-shim.cjs"]
    RN["openclaw_assistant/render_nginx.py"] --> NT["openclaw_assistant/nginx.conf.tpl"]
  end
  subgraph MAINT["Maintenance"]
    OH["openclaw_assistant/oc-health.sh"]
    OC["openclaw_assistant/oc-config.sh"]
  end
  RS --> OC
  RS --> RN
  RS --> OG
  OG --> PS

explication: config.yaml et le Dockerfile définissent l'add-on, dont run.sh orchestre le démarrage. Il génère la config nginx, lance la passerelle OpenClaw avec son proxy shim et surveille l'état avec oc-health.sh.
source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: config.yaml and the Dockerfile define the add-on, whose startup is orchestrated by run.sh. It generates the nginx config, launches the OpenClaw gateway with its proxy shim and monitors the state with oc-health.sh.
